data.description:
testing_mode: GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD1: plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/ exists with _schema.yaml defining 6 tag dimensions.
DD3: check-corpus-schema hook registered in .pre-commit-config.yaml.

## Prerequisites (must be complete before this task)
- plugin-boundary allowlist entry (task a951-b4c1) must be committed first — otherwise corpus file commits fail pre-commit
- check-corpus-schema.py/.sh (task [task-2-id]) must be committed — hook calls the script
- docs/ui-reference-sources.yaml provenance (task defe-e122) should be complete

## Context
Create the corpus directory structure, define the schema vocabulary, author 9 seed entries, and register the pre-commit hook. The allowlist entry (task a951-b4c1) must be in place before committing these files.

## Schema (_schema.yaml)
Define 6 tag dimensions:
- domain: (government, healthcare, finance, education, civic, general)
- component: (form, navigation, search, layout, typography, data-display)
- action: (create, read, update, delete, upload, navigate)
- compliance: (wcag-aa, section-508, plain-language, mobile-first)
- severity: (critical, major, minor, informational)
- story_type: (epic, story, task, spike)

## Seed Entries (9 minimum, 1 per top domain/component combination)
Each entry file: plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/<slug>.yaml with YAML frontmatter containing title, domain, component, action, compliance, severity, story_type, source_url, summary.

## Pre-commit Hook Registration (.pre-commit-config.yaml)
Add check-corpus-schema hook entry pointing to plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.sh.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/_schema.yaml exists with 6 tag dimensions and vocabulary
- [ ] ≥9 .yaml entry files in plugins/dso/data/ui-reference/ (not counting _schema.yaml or _index.yaml)
- [ ] Each entry has valid frontmatter conforming to _schema.yaml vocabulary
- [ ] check-corpus-schema hook registered in .pre-commit-config.yaml
- [ ] Schema validator passes on all 9 seed entries (pre-commit runs clean)
- [ ] All files committed successfully (requires allowlist entry from task a951-b4c1)

## Retry Budget: 3
data.title: GREEN: Create _schema.yaml, 9 seed entries, register pre-commit hook
